newsitem.title: CHINA: China raises 1996 grain output figure to 490 mln T.
newsitem.headline: China raises 1996 grain output figure to 490 mln T.

text.p: China has revised its total 1996 grain output to 490 million tonnes from an estimated 480 million tonnes, Zhang Sai, director of the State Statistical Bureau said on Friday.
Zhang told reporters the additional 10 million tonnes reflected overestimates of the impact on the harvest from floods and other natural disasters last year.
Zhang said the new figure meant an increase of five percent over the 1995 total.
But the official also cautioned that the latest figure was preliminary and could be revised again.
"There are difficulties collecting figures across such a big country," he said.
He also conceded that China had problems with exaggerrated or understated statistics in some areas, but said its macro-economic data was reliable.
Some industry analysts had expressed doubts about the accuracy of the 480 million tonne figure, saying that it might have been overstated.
